turns.prompt_text: I would like to export all my photos in a way that they can be all visible from an Excalibur I know I can't do them all at once cuz there's so many so I would like to match them into groups and then put them all into an excellent job page so that I can go through and start them myself
turns.response_html:
To manage a massive library in Excel, you should export your data in dated batches or by thematic categories to keep the file size functional.

Recommended Workflow

  • Export by Year/Month: Use Google Takeout to download photos in chronological chunks (e.g., 2025, 2024). This prevents Excel from lagging due to massive row counts.
  • Extract Metadata: Use a tool like ExifTool or a Python script to pull the "Date Taken," "Location," and "File Name" into a .csv file.
  • Excel Integration: Import each .csv into a separate sheet or a master table. Use the HYPERLINK function to link the file path so you can click and view the photo directly from the cell.
  • Grouping Strategy: Organize by your frequent activities like Military (Iraq/Fort Sill), DIY/Tools, or your dogs Addie and Poppie.

Would you like me to write a Python script to automate extracting the metadata into a spreadsheet for you?
